LanguageData.PV_Shroud_EffectsTooltip: Controls subtle 3D nebula drift and frontier edge glow across unexplored Fog of War territory.
LanguageData.PV_Shroud_ReduceMotionTooltip: Freezes procedural nebula drift and frontier glow pulsing into a static appearance.
LanguageData.PV_Shroud_OptimiseTerrainTooltip: Skips rendering fully shrouded terrain mesh chunks beneath the Fog of War shell while keeping tile selection and pathing intact.
LanguageData.PV_Shroud_CloudsTooltip: Keeps the planetary cloud layer subtly visible when zoomed in to the Geoscape, fading smoothly into full orbital clouds when zooming out.
